svg.title: The numbers. ~2× per-person SQL throughput with RAG text-to-SQL. ~900 validated SQL queries over a 4,000+ table schema. 330+ regression scripts automated, the most on my team. ~40 testers adopted the Chrome extension I built. 1–2 hrs per impact report, down from 1–2 weeks (100+ reports). 1000+ DSA problems solved CodeChef 3★ · GFG 1788.
